purpose: Held-out parity coverage ledger; measured and not_measured are intentionally distinct.

morgan_ecfp.boundary: RDKit-exact ECFP4 sparse counts, folded bits, and raw/folded provenance on the committed oracle corpus

maccs.boundary: 166 logical MACCS keys on 5,000 identical SMILES inputs; Rust CLI versus RDKit, with the documented unused RDKit bit 0 mapping

topological.boundary: RDKit-compatible RDKFingerprint configuration on 5,000 identical SMILES inputs; Rust CLI versus RDKit with exact bit-set comparison; native topo_path remains a separate algorithm

torsion.boundary: RDKit-compatible hashed topological torsion fingerprint on 5,000 identical SMILES inputs; Rust CLI versus RDKit with exact bit-set comparison

descriptors.boundary: MW, TPSA, HBD, HBA, and heavy-atom count on the 4,999-row corpus; Python binding versus RDKit, not a full all-binding claim

standardization.oracle: Committed Phase 1 expected fragments; RDKit canonical identity comparison
standardization.boundary: 10 held-out fixtures through the explicit Rust CLI --largest-fragment-only profile; 8/10 expected fragment identities match, with two disclosed charge-neutralization differences; cross-binding parity remains open
